Detailed description of cases when a conversion is sent:
If a new user opens a card and deposits 100 USDT or more within the first 30 days after opening the card – we send this ID.
Example 1: The user opens a card and makes three deposits: 20, 50 and 40 USDT within the first 30 days. Thanks to the third deposit, he exceeded the 100 USDT mark, and together with this deposit of 40 USDT, we send the ID.
Example 2: The user opens a card and makes two deposits: 20 and 50 USDT within the first 30 days, and then another 40 USDT on the 31st day. In this case, the 100 USDT mark was not reached within 30 days, so we do not send anything.
Example 3: The user opens a card and makes one deposit of 200 USDT on the first day. It immediately exceeded the 100 USDT mark, so we send the ID instantly.
